Govt assures language martyr Barkat's family of legal assistance
2014-02-20T00:00:20+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Gazipur
https://www.thedailystar.net/govt-assures-language-martyr-barkats-family-of-legal-assistance-12175

Officials concerned yesterday assured the family of Language Movement martyr Shaheed Barkat of providing them legal assistance on a dispute over a piece of land given to them by the government. Following a report published Tuesday in different dailies, including The Daily Star, Gazipur Nezarat Deputy Collector Sazid Anwar and Sadar Upazila Nirbahi Officer Fouzia Khanam visited them. The report said Safar Ali, councillor of ward no-18 in the city, had been demanding extortion money from them, an allegation he denied. Barkat's nephew Ain Uddin Barkat said Safar filed a case with the land office concerned saying that the people, who had been possessing the 0.68 acres of land at Kacharibari, were not the heirs of Shaheed Barkat.

The ward councillor applied to the deputy commissioner and the assistant commissioner (land) requesting not to provide them Review Survey mutation although they had applied for it, he added. Ain Uddin lodged a complaint to the deputy commissioner Tuesday alleging that the ward councillor harassed them over the land.
